snippet.title: ECHOLAND | Official Teaser Trailer（English）
snippet.description:
ECHOLAND is an idle mining game that quietly continues digging away in the corner of your desktop. Unearth the traces of humanity on an Earth where no one remains. The past cannot be changed. — But its memories can still be uncovered.
